title: The Ology: Ancient Truths, Ever New
author: Marty Machowski
description: Systematic theology for families — 55 beautifully illustrated lessons covering God, creation, sin, salvation, and the Holy Spirit in language children actually understand.

title: Teach Me to Pray: Praying God's Word from A to Z
author: Kristen Wetherell
description: An alphabet-driven prayer primer that teaches children to pray using the words of Scripture — from Adoration to Zeal, every letter becomes a conversation with God.

title: More Than a Story: Old Testament
author: Sally Michael
description: Goes beyond the surface narrative to show children the theological depth of every Old Testament story — ideal for family devotions or Sunday school.

title: More Than a Story: New Testament
author: Sally Michael
description: Explores the Gospels and Epistles with children, drawing out rich doctrinal truth from familiar stories and teaching them to read the Bible as one unified message.

title: The Biggest Story Bible Storybook
author: Kevin DeYoung
description: Sixty-six stories — one for every book of the Bible — each written to show how the entire Scripture points to the same Savior. Vivid illustrations by Don Clark.

title: 365 Great Bible Stories: The Good News of Jesus from Genesis to Revelation
author: Carine MacKenzie
description: A story for every day of the year — from Genesis to Revelation — written with clarity and warmth, showing how the whole Bible is one great story of redemption.

title: The Jesus Storybook Bible: Every Story Whispers His Name
author: Sally Lloyd-Jones
description: The beloved classic that shows every story in the Bible — from the very beginning to the very end — is really one story: a never-stopping, never-giving-up, unbreakable love story.

title: His Grace Is Enough: How God Makes It Right When We've Got It Wrong
author: Melissa Kruger
description: A beautifully gentle board book that introduces toddlers to the concept of grace — that God loves us even when we mess up, and makes things right through Jesus.

title: Man Who Preached Outside
author: Rebecca VanDoodewaard
description: The story of George Whitefield — the open-air evangelist who preached to thousands in fields and streets. A vivid board book introduction to one of history's boldest gospel preachers.

title: Woman Who Helped a Reformer
author: Rebecca VanDoodewaard
description: The story of Katharina Luther — the former nun who married Martin Luther and became the heart of the Reformation household. A beautiful board book about a woman of quiet faith and great courage.

title: The Woman Who Loved to Give Books
author: Rebecca VanDoodewaard
description: The story of Susannah Spurgeon — wife of Charles Spurgeon — who used her health struggles to start a book fund that sent thousands of Christian books to poor pastors across England.

title: The Doctor Who Became a Preacher
author: Rebecca VanDoodewaard
description: The story of Martyn Lloyd-Jones — the Welsh doctor who left medicine to become one of the 20th century's greatest preachers. A board book showing how God redirects even brilliant careers for His glory.

title: The Holy Spirit
author: Devon Provencher
description: Part of the 'Big Theology for Little Hearts' series — a beautifully illustrated board book introducing the youngest children to who the Holy Spirit is and what He does in the lives of believers.

title: Little Pilgrim's Progress
author: Helen L. Taylor, illustrated by Joe Sutphin
description: Bunyan's timeless allegory reimagined for children with stunning new illustrations by Joe Sutphin — woodland animal characters guide young Christian through the journey from the City of Destruction to the Celestial City.

title: Sophie and the Heidelberg Cat
author: Andrew Wilson
description: A charming picture book that introduces children to the Heidelberg Catechism through the story of young Sophie and a very theological cat.

title: The King and the Dragon
author: James W. Shrimpton
description: A gospel allegory dressed as a fairy tale — a king battles a fearsome dragon in a story that echoes the great victory of Christ over sin and death.

title: The Sower
author: Scott James
description: A beautifully illustrated picture book retelling the Parable of the Sower, helping children understand how God's Word takes root differently in different hearts.

title: John Calvin's Illustrated Institutes: Book 1
author: REFTOONS
description: Calvin's Institutes made visual — a graphic adaptation of Chapters 1–5 of Book 1, covering the knowledge of God and knowledge of ourselves. Theology you can see.

title: The Knight's Map
author: R.C. Sproul
description: A medieval knight receives a map from the King — an allegory about the Bible as our guide through life, beautifully illustrated for young readers.

title: The Lightlings
author: R.C. Sproul
description: Tiny creatures called Lightlings fear the darkness around them — a beautiful parable of the Fall and redemption, pointing children toward the true Light of the world.

title: The Donkey Who Carried a King
author: R.C. Sproul
description: Told from the perspective of the donkey on Palm Sunday — a humble, whimsical story that shows every creature has a role in glorifying the King of kings.

title: The Priest with Dirty Clothes
author: R.C. Sproul
description: Based on Zechariah 3, a story about a filthy priest and a gracious King — a profound picture of justification told through a gentle, illustrated allegory.

title: Nugget and the Refiner
author: Kerry Tittle
description: A nugget of gold in the hands of a skilled refiner — an illustrated story of sanctification, helping children understand how God uses trials to purify our hearts.

title: David and the Very Big Giant
author: Tim Thornborough & Jennifer Davison
description: The beloved story of David and Goliath retold with joyful illustrations — showing young children that God is bigger than any giant we face.

title: Daniel and the Very Hungry Lions
author: Tim Thornborough & Jennifer Davison
description: Daniel faces a den of very hungry lions — a cheerful retelling of a fearless faith that God honors, perfect for the youngest readers.

title: Lady Jane Grey
author: Simonetta Carr
description: The story of England's nine-day queen who died for her Protestant faith at just sixteen — a biography of courage, conviction, and trust in God's sovereignty.

title: Charles Haddon Spurgeon
author: Simonetta Carr
description: The Prince of Preachers — from his conversion at fifteen to filling the Metropolitan Tabernacle, Spurgeon's life shows what God does with a heart fully surrendered.

title: John Calvin
author: Simonetta Carr
description: The story of a shy scholar who became one of the most influential theologians in Christian history — Carr brings Calvin to life for a new generation of young readers.
